cases.name: Dr. Rebecca Lacey "Becky" Sorrow
cases.about: Sorrow was a psychologist in Anderson Co. Her obituary said, "Dr. Sorrow received her PHD in Psychology from the University of Georgia, and had a private practice in Anderson, SC."
